$comment: S1 author catalog. Selecting authors is NOT a search problem — the goal is a set of
directions that genuinely disagree, so what matters is where each author SITS, not
which one best matches the brief. A lexical ranker structurally cannot do that: it
clusters similar things at the top, which is the opposite of divergence.
Axes are coordinates, not scores. `argues` is the line worth reading — a one-sentence
claim the author makes about how a page should behave.
This is hand-classified and therefore fallible. Correct an entry the moment a board
proves it wrong; a catalog that is never edited is a catalog nobody checked.

Membership here IS the taste declaration. check-skills validates by allowlist: an author must appear in this file AND declare kind 'taste'. A derived denylist was tried first and failed the way denylists do — `diagnose`, `tdd` and `triage` were in neither source, so they passed --strict and were eligible for --diverge.

high-end-visual-design.argues: expense reads as restraint plus one expensive detail, not as more elements

gpt-taste.argues: wide editorial typography and pinned scroll sequences carry the page

minimalist-ui.argues: typographic contrast alone can carry hierarchy; effects are an admission of failure

industrial-brutalist-ui.argues: the interface should look like the machine it is, not like a brochure about it

design-taste-frontend.argues: infer the direction from the brief and refuse the templated default

editorial-tech.argues: magazine composition with instrument-panel precision; mono labels do the tech work

editorial-portfolio-chapters.argues: the work leads and the site is its chaptering; full-bleed media over UI

editorial-service-booking.argues: an operational flow can stay warm and editorial without losing trust

documentary-brutalist-agency.argues: billboard type and an exposed grid; the collage is evidence, not decoration

book-serif-index.argues: a page is for sustained reading; the index and the margin are the interface

agency-grid-layout-minimal.argues: a disciplined grid plus oversized type; quiet uppercase labels carry utility

split-layout-technical.argues: two panels in dialogue; fine frame lines and mono metadata set the register

technical-wireframe-info-layout.argues: show the construction — exploded structure with connector annotations

framed-grid-layout.argues: visible boundaries and corner brackets make the layout legible as a system

image-first-grid-layout.argues: photography is the content; type annotates and never competes

nested-container-clean-agency.argues: containers inside containers; the inset dark block is the emphasis device

nested-container-frames.argues: nesting itself encodes level; the outer frame declares the page bounds

light-mode-paper-technical.argues: warm paper inside dark framing; precision reads as care, not coldness

clean-minimal-beige-light-mode.argues: low contrast held together by rhythm; the quiet grid is the whole idea

orange-clean-paper-saas.argues: warm neutrals with one signal colour; product illustration does the explaining

high-contrast-skeuomorphic-clean.argues: molded surfaces and crisp light separation; depth is tactile, not decorative

skeuomorphic-ui.argues: controls should look pressable; material and light do the affordance work

operational-enterprise-ai.argues: explain boundaries, approvals and rollback; the metric pause is the proof

product-proof-saas.argues: the product interface is the hero; a real workflow outranks a claim

glass-dark-ui.argues: frosted depth with readable contrast; the gradient border is the edge language

dark-glass-clean-layout.argues: a premium workspace shell; floating data cards over calm atmosphere

blue-laser-clean-glass-layout.argues: one thin beam of light organises the whole dark surface

mesh-gradient-dark-blue-clean.argues: procedural depth as infrastructure; minimal structure floats on it

funky-purple-container-tech.argues: playful futurism; the focal object is allowed to be the point

dark-blue-contrasting-clean.argues: hard contrast blocks rather than gradients; restraint in the glow

tech-green-dark-mode-modern.argues: matte black with a single signal hue; mono labels as system chrome

blue-cloudy-clean-modern.argues: luminous sky as ground; serenity is the product claim

dither-laser-dark-mode.argues: ordered dither gives the black a texture; the beam gives it a direction

glass-dark-mode-clock.argues: instrument framing — dials and calibration marks as the organising metaphor

bright-green-tech-system-webgl.argues: a hard-framed shell around a live visualisation zone

build-awwwards-quality-sites.argues: motion choreography is the concept; the hero must be a standout moment
